description: This file defines the implementation of the GraphingSettingsViewModel class, which manages the state and behavior of graphing settings in a calculator application, including range initialization, resetting view, updating display ranges, and error handling.

classes.name: GraphingSettingsViewModel
classes.description: A view model class that manages graphing settings such as ranges, errors, and trig units for a graphing calculator.

methods.name: GraphingSettingsViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing default values for the graphing settings view model.

methods.name: SetGrapher
methods.description: Associates a grapher object with the view model and initializes ranges, setting default trig unit if invalid.

methods.name: InitRanges
methods.description: Initializes the display ranges for the graph based on the current graph object.

methods.name: ResetView
methods.description: Resets the graph grid and ranges, clears error states, and raises property change notifications.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayRange
methods.description: Updates the graph display ranges if no errors are present and the graph object is valid.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Checks if any error flags are set in the view model.
